mapper.sql: eqp_id, conn_state, since_at, last_connect_at, last_disconnect_at, last_rx_at, last_tx_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_eqp_conn_state (eqp_id, conn_state, since_at, last_connect_at, last_disconnect_at, last_rx_at, last_tx_at, last_error_code, last_error_message) VALUES (#{s.eqpId}, #{s.connState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, /* since_at NOT NULL 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{s.lastConnectAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.lastDisconnectAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.lastRxAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.lastTxAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.lastErrorCode}, #{s.lastErrorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_eqp_conn_state SET conn_state = #{s.connState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, since_at = COALESCE(#{s.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, since_at), last_connect_at = #{s.lastConnectAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, last_disconnect_at = #{s.lastDisconnectAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, last_rx_at = #{s.lastRxAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, last_tx_at = #{s.lastTxAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, last_error_code = #{s.lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{s.lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_id = #{s.eqpId}
